description: This file implements Bloom filter functionalities for the Git project, including creation, loading from commit graphs, and checking membership. It includes hash functions, filter initialization, and interactions with commit graphs and repository data.

classes.name: bloom_filter_slab
classes.description: A slab memory management structure for bloom filters.

classes.name: bloom_filter
classes.description: A data structure representing a bloom filter, including data, length, version, and optional free function.

classes.name: bloom_key
classes.description: A structure representing a bloom filter key with hash values.

classes.name: bloom_keyvec
classes.description: A vector of bloom filter keys, used for batch operations.

classes.name: pathmap_hash_entry
classes.description: An entry in a hashmap representing a file path and associated data.

methods.name: uint32_t rotate_left(uint32_t value,int32_t count)
methods.description: Performs a bitwise rotate left operation on a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: unsigned char get_bitmask(uint32_t pos)
methods.description: Returns a bitmask with a single bit set based on position.

methods.name: int check_bloom_offset(struct commit_graph * g,uint32_t pos,uint32_t offset)
methods.description: Checks if a bloom offset is within valid range in the commit graph data.

methods.name: int load_bloom_filter_from_graph(struct commit_graph * g,struct bloom_filter * filter,uint32_t graph_pos)
methods.description: Loads a bloom filter from the commit graph at a specific position.

methods.name: uint32_t murmur3_seeded_v2(uint32_t seed,const char * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Computes Murmur3 32-bit hash with seed, version 2.

methods.name: uint32_t murmur3_seeded_v1(uint32_t seed,const char * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Computes Murmur3 32-bit hash with seed, version 1.

methods.name: void bloom_key_fill(struct bloom_key * key,const char * data,size_t len,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Fills a bloom key with hash values based on input data and settings.

methods.name: void bloom_key_clear(struct bloom_key * key)
methods.description: Clears the hashes in a bloom key.

methods.name: void add_key_to_filter(const struct bloom_key * key,struct bloom_filter * filter,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Adds a bloom key to a bloom filter.

methods.name: void init_bloom_filters(void)
methods.description: Initializes the slab allocator for bloom filters.

methods.name: void free_one_bloom_filter(struct bloom_filter * filter)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a bloom filter.

methods.name: void deinit_bloom_filters(void)
methods.description: Deinitializes the bloom filter slab, freeing all filters.

methods.name: struct:bloom_keyvec * bloom_keyvec_new(const char * path,size_t len,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Creates a new vector of bloom keys from a file path.

methods.name: void bloom_keyvec_free(struct bloom_keyvec * vec)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a bloom key vector.

methods.name: void init_truncated_large_filter(struct bloom_filter * filter,int version)
methods.description: Initializes a bloom filter as truncated due to size constraints.

methods.name: int has_entries_with_high_bit(struct repository * r,struct tree * t)
methods.description: Checks whether a tree has entries with the high bit set.

methods.name: int commit_tree_has_high_bit_paths(struct repository * r,struct commit * c)
methods.description: Checks if a commit's tree has entries with high bit set.

methods.name: struct:bloom_filter * upgrade_filter(struct repository * r,struct commit * c,struct bloom_filter * filter,int hash_version)
methods.description: Upgrades a bloom filter to a new hash version if possible.

methods.name: struct:bloom_filter * get_bloom_filter(struct repository * r,struct commit * c)
methods.description: Retrieves a bloom filter for a specific commit.

methods.name: struct:bloom_filter * get_or_compute_bloom_filter(struct repository * r,struct commit * c,int compute_if_not_present,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings,enum bloom_filter_computed * computed)
methods.description: Retrieves or computes a bloom filter for a commit, possibly upgrading or generating it.

methods.name: int bloom_filter_contains(const struct bloom_filter * filter,const struct bloom_key * key,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Checks if a bloom filter contains a given key.

methods.name: int bloom_filter_contains_vec(const struct bloom_filter * filter,const struct bloom_keyvec * vec,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Checks if a bloom filter contains all keys in a key vector.

methods.name: uint32_t test_bloom_murmur3_seeded(uint32_t seed,const char * data,size_t len,int version)
methods.description: Tests Murmur3 hashing with a seed and version.

methods.name: int pathmap_cmp(const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: unavailable
